title: AgentIdentity
description: Who an Agent is. Protocol sdk.syberlabs.space/v1alpha1. Same tuple as Turtle's TurtleIdentity (turtle-shells, crates/turtle-policy): id, root_id, parent_id, subject_binding. A root Agent has parent_id null and root_id equal to id. subject_binding names the principal the Agent acts for, never a credential. platform uses the Agent-platform convention from SyberWork AGENTS.md section 2, optionally name@revision.
